metaDescription: Order custom gold work shirts in bulk at Perfect Imprints. Ideal for safety teams and promotions. Fast turnaround.
introHtml: Gold work shirts offer high visibility and a professional look for construction crews, warehouse teams, and event staff. Unlike standard safety colors, gold provides a warm, attention-grabbing hue that stands out without being harsh. These shirts pair well with screen-printed logos or embroidered company names, making them a practical choice for businesses that need both function and brand recognition. Choose from short-sleeve or long-sleeve styles in durable cotton or poly-blend fabrics.
heroAltText: Custom gold work shirts for men and women, short sleeve, with logo embroidery, stacked on a table
